claims.statement: Tom Allen accepted Gallagher's proposal to leave the stakes on deposit and add $1,900 (printed as $1,900).
claims.excerpt: Tom will leave the stakes on deposit and add $1,900

claims.statement: Allen would name a place within fifty miles of Cincinnati for the fight, to take place in a week or ten days.
claims.excerpt: in a week or ten days, within fifty miles of

claims.statement: Allen was to meet Gallagher at 3 o'clock on Saturday afternoon to draw up articles.
claims.excerpt: He will meet Charlie Gallagher at 3 o'clock

notes: Note signed by Wm. Carroll for Allen. The $1,900 is probably OCR for $1,000, as in the 359 account, but the printed figure is recorded. Hint about the place was kept only as far as the note says.
